adjudication.rationale: The handler first checks `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED) return 403` (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts). `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (packages/lib/constants.ts), so if `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset (undefined/empty), the endpoint is disabled and the request is rejected before the header comparison runs. Therefore omitting the header cannot “open” the endpoint when the secret is unset based on this diff.
